name: Baked Ragi Murukku
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: ½ tsp each cumin seeds and ajwain
¼ tsp chilli powder and pinch of hing
steps: Mix all the dry ingredients and oil, then add enough warm water to make a smooth, soft dough.
Fill a murukku press (or a piping bag with a star nozzle) with the dough.
Press into small coils or spirals on a lined baking tray.
Bake at 180°C for 22–25 minutes, turning the tray once, until crisp and lightly browned.
Cool completely; they crisp as they cool.
note: A baked version of the South Indian snack, traditionally made with butter and deep-fried; the besan boosts the protein.
